clean.title: Definitive dominates in Class 2 as Purton reaches milestone at Sha Tin

blocks.text: Definitive (115lb) left no room for doubt at Sha Tin this afternoon (Sunday, 4 October), pouncing under Karis Teetan to win the HK$3.12 million Class 2 Muk Min Ha Handicap (1650m, dirt) and add further fuel to trainer David Eustace’s form in the new season.

Eustace celebrated a second Group 3 win in Hong Kong last Thursday (1 October) with Colourful King before Definitive secured the third-season handler’s fifth win this term as the recipient of a cracking ride from Teetan aboard the five-year-old War Decree gelding.

Stepping from barrier seven, Definitive positioned behind leader Sing Dragon (127lb), while Sky Vino (115lb) held third on the rail. Turning for home, Teetan pressured the leader before taking over at the 400m, scoring by two-and-a-quarter lengths in 1m 38s.

Teetan said: “He went down to the gates feeling good and when he came out so well, I thought, that’s halfway home already. He was able to control the race and he picked it up nicely. He had no weight on his back and he was in the perfect spot.
“I always knew he had ability, and sometimes it’s just about him bringing his ‘A game’ to the races, too. I must say, well done to David and his team – they had the horse spot on.”
Talents Ambition (128lb) finished second with Sky Vino grabbing third. Eustace expects Definitive will seek a fourth Happy Valley win after today’s breakthrough in Class 2.
Definitive defeats Talents Ambition and Sky Vino at Sha Tin.

“He got a beautiful ride and the setup of the race worked out well for him. He’s got to take his medicine from the handicapper, and there are not too many options for him on the dirt, but he’s got a very effective record at Happy Valley,” Eustace said.

Racing in the same silks as triple Group 1 winner Mr Stunning for owner Maurice Koo and trainer Frankie Lor, Mr Cool (126lb) dashed to victory in the Class 4 Yan Chai Trophy Handicap (1400m), capping a double for Teetan.

Lor also grabbed two of his own when Horsepower (135lb) nicked the Class 3 Shing Mun Handicap (1000m) under Andrea Atzeni. The Harry Angel gelding is owned by Michael Lee, former Chairman of The Hong Kong Jockey Club, and his family.

Zac Purton reached 1,100 wins on the Sha Tin turf as Michael Chang’s Lady’s Love (129lb) claimed the Class 4 Sham Tseng Handicap (1400m). Purton kicked off his double aboard KOL (122lb) in the Class 4 Kwok Shui Handicap (1200m) for David Hayes.

Chang said: “Today has been lucky on my side, as both my horses drew barrier one. This horse (Lady’s Love), Zac came back and said he does a few things wrong – he doesn’t fully concentrate. I think he still has a couple of lengths left to improve further.”

Purton, a nine-time Hong Kong Champion Jockey, leads the 2026/27 standings with 14 wins – six clear of his nearest rivals. The winningest rider in Hong Kong racing history, 43-year-old Purton has notched 2,035 wins in the city since arriving in 2007/08.

Team Happy (124lb) began Chang’s double under Matthew Poon, taking out the Class 5 Lo Wai Handicap (1400m), while Hayes also trained two victors as All Round Winner (120lb) skimmed the inside rail to strike under Harry Bentley in the Class 3 Shek Wai Kok Handicap (1650m, dirt).
Double Bingo (128lb) edged to Class 5 Chai Wan Kok Handicap (1650m, dirt) success under Nichola Yuen for trainer Ricky Yiu. Victory is the seven-pound apprentice’s sixth from the past four fixtures.
Big Return (120lb) made his first appearance over nine furlongs a winning one, taking the Class 3 Chinese Recreation Club Challenge Cup Handicap (1800m) under Alexis Badel for trainer Jamie Richards.

After interference from Firefoot (123lb), Supreme Agility (131lb) was declared the winner of the Class 4 Sha Tsui Handicap (1650m, dirt) following an inquiry and objection after initially finishing second with jockey James Orman for trainer Pierre Ng.

Ng said: “He’s quite a different horse this season. It took him a long while to build up this good form. He showed in a trial he’s much sharper now, so I’m looking forward to him running in Class 3 from a light weight.”

Six-year-old Bunta Baby (127lb) and jockey Luke Ferraris denied Four-Year-Old Classic Series potential Solid State (135lb) in the Class 3 Yau Kom Tau Handicap (1200m). The gelding savoured a fourth career win for trainer Manfred Man at odds of 38/1.
Hong Kong racing continues at Happy Valley on Wednesday (7 October).

target.title: Definitive在Class 2中称霸，Purton在Sha Tin达成里程碑
target.summary: Definitive在Sha Tin赢得Class 2 Muk Min Ha Handicap，为David Eustace再添胜绩；Purton在Sha Tin达成1,100胜里程碑，Frankie Lor和Lor各取两胜。
target.body:
Definitive（115磅）今天下午（10月4日星期日）在Sha Tin没有留下任何疑问，在田泰安策骑下发力，赢得奖金312万港元的Class 2 Muk Min Ha Handicap（1650米，泥地），为练马师David Eustace在新赛季的佳绩再添动力。

Eustace上周四（10月1日）在Hong Kong凭借Colourful King庆祝了第二场Group 3胜利，随后Definitive在Teetan策骑这匹五岁War Decree阉马的出色发挥下，为这位执教第三个赛季的练马师取得本赛季第五场胜利。

Definitive从第七档起步，位置在领放马Sing Dragon（127磅）之后，而Sky Vino（115磅）在内栏守住第三。转直路时，Teetan向领放马施压，并在400米处取得领先，以两个又四分之一马位之差、1分38秒的成绩胜出。

Teetan说：“他前往闸厢时感觉很好，出闸又那么顺利，我当时想，这已经成功一半了。他能够控制比赛，并且很好地加速。他背上没有负重，而且处于完美的位置。

“我一直知道他很有能力，有时关键就在于他能否在比赛中拿出最佳状态。我必须说，David和他的团队做得很好——他们把这匹马调教得恰到好处。”

Talents Ambition（128磅）获得第二，Sky Vino取得第三。Eustace预计，Definitive在今天于Class 2取得突破后，将争取第四场Happy Valley胜利。

Definitive在Sha Tin击败Talents Ambition和Sky Vino。

“他得到了一次漂亮的策骑，比赛形势对他很有利。他必须承受让磅评分带来的加磅，而且在泥地上没有太多选择，但他在Happy Valley有着非常有效的战绩，”Eustace说。

与三届Group 1冠军Mr Stunning同属马主Maurice Koo和练马师Frankie Lor的同一彩衣，Mr Cool（126磅）在Class 4 Yan Chai Trophy Handicap（1400米）中冲刺取胜，为Teetan完成当日两胜。

Lor也取得自己的两胜，其中Horsepower（135磅）在艾兆礼策骑下险胜Class 3 Shing Mun Handicap（1000米）。这匹Harry Angel阉马由The Hong Kong Jockey Club前主席Michael Lee及其家人拥有。

潘顿在Sha Tin草地达成1,100胜，Michael Chang的Lady’s Love（129磅）赢得Class 4 Sham Tseng Handicap（1400米）。潘顿则在David Hayes旗下的KOL（122磅）于Class 4 Kwok Shui Handicap（1200米）中展开他的当日两胜。

Chang说：“今天对我来说很幸运，因为我的两匹马都抽到第一档。这匹马（Lady’s Love），Zac回来说他做错了一些事情——他没有完全集中注意力。我认为他还有几个马位的提升空间。”

Purton，九届Hong Kong Champion Jockey，以14场胜利领跑2026/27赛季积分榜——领先最接近的对手六场。作为Hong Kong赛马史上胜场最多的骑师，43岁的Purton自2007/08赛季来港以来已在本地取得2,035场胜利。

Team Happy（124磅）在Matthew Poon策骑下展开Chang的当日两胜，赢得Class 5 Lo Wai Handicap（1400米），而Hayes同样取得两胜，All Round Winner（120磅）沿内栏贴栏冲刺，在班德礼策骑下赢得Class 3 Shek Wai Kok Handicap（1650米，泥地）。

Double Bingo（128磅）在Nichola Yuen策骑下险胜Class 5 Chai Wan Kok Handicap（1650米，泥地），为练马师Ricky Yiu取得胜利。这是这位减七磅见习骑师在过去四个赛马日中的第六场胜利。

Big Return（120磅）首次出赛九化郎即取胜，在巴度策骑下为练马师Jamie Richards赢得Class 3 Chinese Recreation Club Challenge Cup Handicap（1800米）。

在受到Firefoot（123磅）干扰后，Supreme Agility（131磅）经研讯及抗议后被宣布为Class 4 Sha Tsui Handicap（1650米，泥地）冠军；此前由骑师柯敏为练马师Pierre Ng策骑的它最初获得第二。

Ng说：“本赛季他完全是另一匹马。他花了很长时间才建立这种良好状态。他在一次试闸中显示出自己现在锐利得多，所以我期待他以轻磅出战Class 3。”

六岁马Bunta Baby（127磅）和骑师霍宏声在Class 3 Yau Kom Tau Handicap（1200米）中击败了Four-Year-Old Classic Series有潜力的Solid State（135磅）。这匹阉马以38/1的赔率为练马师Manfred Man赢得职业生涯第四场胜利。

Hong Kong赛马将于周三（10月7日）在Happy Valley继续。

clean.title: Tim Easterby pays tribute as Copper Knight retires

blocks.text: Tim Easterby paid tribute to Copper Knight after the 12-year-old ran the final race of his remarkable career at York on Friday.
He was running for the 128th time when finishing seventh in the Copper Knight Winning-Most Horse Handicap, a race honouring his record-breaking success at the Knavesmire.
Copper Knight won 20 races in total, seven at York, more than any other horse in the track's history.

“He’s been fantastic. Every time he’s been out there he’s come and run his race. It takes a fair bit of doing what he’s done, to keep going and be sound, and want to go to the line is amazing. He ran a super race there," the trainer said.

“It’s been a brilliant time. When you need that speed at the three-furlong pole, he just doesn’t have that like he used to. You’ve got to remember he ran in a Nunthorpe here as well, which was fantastic, and he also loved going round Chester, too.
“We might find another one like him, but I don’t think we will. Everybody loves him in the yard and across Yorkshire. He’s been just wonderful.”
Exciting Sharadd reamins unbeaten
Sharadd retained his unbeaten record with a workmanlike success in the William Hill Epic Boosts EBF Novice Stakes at York.
William Haggas’ charge made a sparkling start to his career when winning on debut at Haydock last month but Our Son Oscar provided a much sterner test of his credentials on Friday.

Tom Marquand travelled strongly on the 4/9 winner throughout the contest but the runner-up, racing more towards the centre of the track, fought on bravely once the market leader had gone to the front.
However at the line Sharadd had put a length-and-a-half between himself and his rival on what is likely to be his final run of the campaign.

Maureen Haggas said: “He got the job done didn’t he and it’s just another step in the learning process. He probably doesn’t want the ground this soft and will have learned a lot today. This is such a different experience to Haydock where it was quiet and lovely, and he was having a look at what was going on here. It’s all education, that’s all we’re doing.

“It’s not my decision on whether that’s it for the year with him – but if it was mine it would be, yes. I think that’s enough – were’ in October now and what else is there from here? He’s not done much wrong. His brother is a sprinter, this fellow is a bit different to him, but I don’t know at the moment re trip but you’ll probably start at this distance I think.

“There’s a very good programme for three-year-old sprinters now if you’re good enough and he’s doing all the right things. At least he had a race today, he’ll have learned more and they have to learn how to race as well as being good. Talent is always enough. They have to become professional and cope with everything that is thrown at them and he’s learning.”

target.title: Tim Easterby致敬Copper Knight退役
target.summary: Tim Easterby在Copper Knight于York完成职业生涯最后一战后向其致敬；这匹12岁赛驹共赢得20场比赛，其中7场在York，创下该赛道纪录。同日，两岁马Sharadd在York的William Hill Epic Boosts EBF Novice Stakes中保持不败，William Haggas与Maureen Haggas评价其表现及后续安排。
target.body:
Tim Easterby在周五于York跑完这匹12岁赛驹非凡职业生涯的最后一场比赛后，向Copper Knight致敬。

这是它第128次出赛，在Copper Knight Winning-Most Horse Handicap中获得第七名；该赛事旨在纪念它在Knavesmire创纪录的成功。

Copper Knight总共赢得20场比赛，其中七场在York，超过该赛道历史上任何其他马匹。

练马师说：“它一直非常出色。每次出赛，它都会上场并跑出自己的水平。要做到它所做到的事，需要相当大的付出——持续奔跑、保持健康，并且仍愿意冲到终点线，这很了不起。它在那里跑了一场超级出色的比赛。”

“那是一段辉煌的时光。当你在三弗隆标杆处需要那种速度时，它就是不再像以前那样拥有那种速度了。你得记住，它也曾在这里跑过Nunthorpe，那非常棒，而且它也很喜欢绕着Chester跑。”

“我们也许还能再找到一匹像它这样的马，但我觉得不会了。马房里每个人都爱它，整个Yorkshire也都爱它。它一直都很了不起。”

令人兴奋的Sharadd保持不败

Sharadd在York举行的William Hill Epic Boosts EBF Novice Stakes中以一场勤勉稳健的胜利保住了不败纪录。

William Haggas麾下这匹赛驹上月在于Haydock的首次出赛中获胜，职业生涯开局亮眼，但周五Our Son Oscar对其能力构成了更严峻的考验。

马昆骑着这匹4/9大热门全程行进强劲，但获得亚军的赛驹更靠赛道中央竞跑，并在市场领头马取得领先之后奋力坚持。

然而在终点线上，Sharadd与对手之间拉开了一个半马位的差距；这很可能是它本赛季的最后一次出赛。

Maureen Haggas说：“它把任务完成了，不是吗？这只是学习过程中的又一步。它大概不喜欢这么软的场地，今天会学到很多。这与Haydock是完全不同的体验，那里安静又舒适，而它在这里还四处张望看发生了什么。这都是教育，我们所做的就是这些。”

“今年是否到此为止不是我的决定——但如果是我的决定，那就会是，是的。我觉得这已经足够了——现在已经十月了，从这里还能去哪里呢？它没做错什么。它的兄弟是短途马，这匹马和它有点不同，但我目前还不知道途程方面如何，不过我想你大概会从这个距离开始。”

“如果你足够优秀，现在三岁短途马有非常好的赛程安排，而它正在做所有正确的事情。至少它今天参加了一场比赛，它会学到更多，而它们也必须学会比赛，同时还要表现出色。天赋总是足够的。它们必须变得职业化，应对抛向它们的一切，而它正在学习。”

“如果你足够优秀，现在三岁短途马有非常好的赛程安排，而它正在做所有正确的事情。至少它今天参加了一场比赛，它会学到更多，而它们也必须学会比赛，同时还要表现出色。天赋总是足够的。它们必须变得职业化，应对抛向它们的一切，而它正在学习。”

clean.title: Second French Jockey Title For Mickael Barzalona

blocks.text: Mickael Barzalona, retained rider for the Aga Khan Studs, won his second Cravache d'Or on Saturday, October 31.

He first won the title in 2021. Barzalona won 176 races in 2026 out of 719 rides. Nine of those wins were at the highest level including the Prix Ganay, the Prix Jacques le Marois and, most notably, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe aboard the Aga Khan Studs' Daryz (Sea The Stars), his second win in the race. Barzalona also was the regular pilot of 2025 G1 Japan Cup hero Calandagan (Gleneagles).

“This Cravache d'Or crowns an extraordinary season for me,” Barzalona said.”Winning the second Cravache d'Or of my career while securing nine Group 1 victories is a source of immense professional satisfaction.

“This year I was fortunate to be paired with two exceptional champions, Daryz and Calandagan, who excelled at the highest level and played a major role in these achievements. None of this would have been possible without the trust placed in me by the Aga Khan stable and trainer Francis-Henri Graffard. I would like to extend a special thank you to them, as well as to all the professionals who have supported me throughout this season.”

巴米高是Aga Khan Studs的常驻骑师，他于10月31日星期六赢得了其第二个Cravache d'Or。

他于2021年首次赢得这一头衔。Barzalona在2026年出赛719次，赢得176场比赛。其中九场胜利属于最高级别赛事，包括Prix Ganay、Prix Jacques le Marois，以及最引人注目的Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe——他策骑Aga Khan Studs的Daryz（Sea The Stars）夺冠，这是他在该赛事中的第二次胜利。Barzalona还经常策骑2025 G1 Japan Cup冠军Calandagan（Gleneagles）。

“这个Cravache d'Or是对我非凡赛季的加冕，”Barzalona说，“在赢得职业生涯第二个Cravache d'Or的同时，收获九场Group 1胜利，这带来了巨大的职业满足感。

“今年我有幸与两匹杰出的冠军马——Daryz和Calandagan——搭档，它们在最高级别赛事中表现出色，并在这些成就中发挥了重要作用。如果没有Aga Khan stable和练马师Francis-Henri Graffard对我的信任，这一切都不可能实现。我想向他们，以及整个赛季支持我的所有专业人士，致以特别的感谢。”

blocks.text: The New York Racing Association has extended its partnership with Oaklawn Park, making America's Day at the Races on FOX Sports the television home of the Hot Springs oval through 2031.

Beginning Nov. 27, America's Day at the Races will provide viewers across the country with in-depth analysis and daily on-site coverage from Oaklawn. The show will expand hours and coverage of the marquee events of the Oaklawn meet, including opening weekend, Smarty Jones day, Southwest and Rebel weekends, Arkansas Derby day, and Apple Blossom and Oaklawn Handicap weekends.

“Our presence on FOX Sports and NYRA's America's Day at the Races is an important part of Oaklawn's commitment to growing the sport of Thoroughbred racing and showcasing our racing program to a national audience,” said Oaklawn President Louis A. Cella. “The broadcast provides an outstanding platform to highlight the quality of our racing, the strength of our stakes program, and the excitement that makes Oaklawn such a special destination for racing fans.”
